fixed-history reward spreading without causal attribution
next_distinct_mechanism.source_admission: Before any original-world run or check/heldout access, independently verify original source owner, current FSA contract, new genuinely disjoint family/seed cohorts, immutable prereg, two-source custody, budget and controller authority.
required_controls: unmodified original native R3 and both separate native parent implementations
fully fitted recurrent/SSM with matched observations, action and budget
learned-effect shuffled and no-memory and no-action-history ablations
required_outcomes: future multi-step public consequence proper scoring on genuine selected events, with calibration and legal source-only inputs
actual on-policy selected goal return and goal count from authentically executed original actions, not unchosen counterfactuals
retention and performance after fresh-process cold restart
action-goal attribution specificity versus matched zero-effect distractors
per-arm whole process CPU/RSS/checkpoint/environment action count, on retail-compatible resources
zero false source provenance, no hidden map, no reward or outcome oracle
next_distinct_mechanism.strongest_control_policy: Any better/equal strongest fully trained control on primary preregistered metric => scientific NO-GO; any absence of action-identifying evidence => NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; any missing authorization => NOT_AUTHORIZED.
next_distinct_mechanism.frozen_thresholds: NONE; design only. The legitimate source owner must freeze thresholds and holdouts before first use; do not retrofit old experiments.

noninterference: No original-world action, model source change, accepted ref/merge, research runner/queue, FORGE owner autonomy or ICE/G29/FSA waiver.
